Updates change only what they're for.

### What's changed
- **Updates leave your shortcuts alone.** Updating with **Update now** no longer puts back a desktop or startup shortcut you removed. Running the setup yourself still applies the ticks you choose.
- **Settings you never changed stay as they are.** The program now saves every setting once, as it is, so a later version with a different default can't change yours. Only settings that are new in an update get a starting value.
- **Templates are never removed when the program starts.** A template the program can't read is left in place instead of being cleared.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients, people and settings.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.14 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.14.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
